title: Verify: AdminApp ExecutionPanel unit tests with mocked fetch
summary: Unit tests for ExecutionPanel rendering inside AdminApp
description: Add tests/adminExecution.test.tsx reusing the url-routing fetch stub pattern of tests/adminStepper.test.tsx and fixtures from tests/fixtures/api.ts.
acceptance_criteria: Test with a full execution asserts count, logs, tests, release version and failure reason
Test with no executions asserts Not available placeholders and count
technical_constraints: fetch mocked via vi.stubGlobal; jsdom environment

steps.action: Export failedExecutionFixture, spreading executionFixture and overriding status 'FAILED', error 'build failed', log 'agent log line', tests 'tests: 3 passed', release_version '1.1.0'. Mirrors ExecutionInfo in game/frontend/src/api/client.ts and execution.Execution in backend/internal/execution/execution.go.
steps.code: export const failedExecutionFixture = { ...executionFixture, status: 'FAILED', error: 'build failed', log: 'agent log line', tests: 'tests: 3 passed', release_version: '1.1.0' };
steps.expected: Type-check passes with the new fixture

steps.symbol: new: AdminApp execution panel (stubFetch, enterToken helpers)
steps.action: Create the file with '// @vitest-environment jsdom', copy the stubFetch/json/enterToken helpers from tests/adminStepper.test.tsx (current-round, admin round, contributions and executions URLs; Bearer secret auth), with stubFetch taking an executions responder.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/adminExecution.test.tsx

steps.symbol: it('Given a FAILED execution with details, when AdminApp loads, then the Execution region shows them')
steps.action: Stub executions to return [failedExecutionFixture]; render AdminApp, enterToken('secret'), await screen.findByRole('region', {name:'Execution'}); assert text contains 'Contributions: 1', 'agent log line', 'tests: 3 passed', '1.1.0' and 'Failure reason: build failed'.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/adminExecution.test.tsx -t 'FAILED execution'

steps.symbol: it('Given no executions, when AdminApp loads, then placeholders are shown')
steps.action: Stub executions to return []; render, enter token, await the Execution region; assert 'Contributions: 1' and that the region has three 'Not available' occurrences for logs, tests and release version plus the duration, and no 'Failure reason' text.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/adminExecution.test.tsx -t 'no executions'
